title: Serial numbers of GST documents
description: The most characters, and the characters besides letters and numerals, that the Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017 allow in the serial number of a tax invoice, a bill of supply, a receipt, refund or payment voucher, a revised tax invoice and a credit or debit note, for financial years from 2026-27, each with its clause in the rule's words; every such number is unique for its financial year.

instruments: Notification No. 10/2017-Central Tax, 28 June 2017, G.S.R. 663(E), Central Goods and Services Tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2017, inserting rules 46 to 53 from 1 July 2017
Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax, 29 January 2019, Central Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Rules, 2019, paragraph 10(d), inserting rule 53(1A) from 1 February 2019

rows.source: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, rule 46(b), inserted by Notification No. 10/2017-Central Tax

cells.words: a consecutive serial number not exceeding sixteen characters, in one or multiple series, containing alphabets or numerals or special characters- hyphen or dash and slash symbolised as "-" and "/" respectively, and any combination thereof, unique for a financial year
